notablePrerequisites:
Old Gnawbone does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Old Gnawbone.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Old Gnawbone.
Old Gnawbone triggers, creating seven Treasure tokens.
Cast Mechanized Production by paying {2}{U}{U}, attaching it to a Treasure token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to win the game.
